name: Meta OS kernel
purpose: Our own Rust kernel: boots to its own text console, schedules tasks, runs ring-3 programs, and answers a shell.
proof: K1-K5 proven by committed boot logs in os-build/logs/; see os-build/KERNEL_STATUS.md
limits: K6 is proven except that no Goose service has a process yet. K7 and later are not claimed.
notes: Kernel source is Rowan's lane; this repository reads it as data only for proof checks.
